title: 第2课 · 我每天六点起床
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 2 — 我每天六点起床 · I get up at six every day

items.zh: 总览 · What this class was about
items.en: Warm-up: in groups we put the eight lines of a dialogue in the right order (a visitor's third trip to China, a dinner invitation, a hotel pick-up). Then a review of HSK 2 Lesson 2: the words (起床, 跑步, 吃药, 生病, 休息, 出院 and 住院) and asking about size with 多 + adjective — 多大, 多高, 多长, 多重, 多远 — with the units 米, 斤, 公斤 and 公里. We finished by asking each other these questions in pairs. A second class continued Lesson 2: 多 with more adjectives and 多长时间, 每 with how often you do things (几次), 几乎 / 差不多, and approximate numbers with 多 and 几 (二十多岁, 一米八几, 十几分钟).

The right order: ask about a first visit → 'no, I've been twice' → 'this is my third time' → dinner invitation → 'you're too kind' → 应该的 → pick-up. The hotel pick-up line can also come right after the invitation; then 'you're too kind' answers the pick-up instead. 第一次 / 第三次 = the first / third time; 以前来过两次 = have been twice before.
see: 会话 · Dialogue (欢迎来中国 Welcome to China)

items.py: Zhè shì wǒ dì sān cì lái Zhōngguó.
items.en: This is my third time in China.
When someone treats you (请您吃晚饭) or offers to pick you up, answer 不用不用，您太客气了 (no need, you're too kind). The host replies 应该的 — 'it's the least I should do', a phrase Chinese people use all the time.
see: 会话 · Dialogue (欢迎来中国 Welcome to China)

items.py: Búyòng búyòng, nín tài kèqi le.

items.en: If you're ill (生病) the doctor may say you have to stay in hospital: 住院 (住 = live, stay + 院 from 医院). When you're better you may leave: 出院 (出 = go out). Then you can go home.

items.zh: 4 · 多 + adjective · How tall, how heavy, how far
items.en: 多大 how old/big, 多高 how tall, 多长 how long, 多重 how heavy, 多远 how far. Units: 米 metre (一米八 = 1.80 m), 公斤 kilogram, 斤 = 500 g (Chinese shops price fruit per 斤), 公里 kilometre (= 一千米). Chinese say 高 for people and buildings and 长 for things lying down, like a table.
see: 练习 · Practice (多高 / 多大 / 多长 / 多重 / 多远)
语法 · Grammar (疑问代词“多” + Adj)

items.py: Nǐ duō gāo? — Wǒ yì mǐ bā.
Zhège zhuōzi duō cháng? — Yì mǐ wǔ.
items.en: How long is this table? — 1.5 m.

items.zh: 从鹿特丹到海牙有多远？——二十公里。
items.py: Cóng Lùtèdān dào Hǎiyá yǒu duō yuǎn? — Èrshí gōnglǐ.
items.en: How far is Rotterdam from The Hague? — 20 km.
一起 + verb = do something together: 一起吃晚饭, 一起学习. Asked whether the ordering exercise was hard, the class said 有点儿难 — reading wasn't hard, finding the order was.
see: 练习 · Practice (住院 / 出院 · 一起)

items.en: 每, how often, and approximate numbers.

Besides 多大, 多高, 多长, 多重, 多远: 多宽 = how wide, and 多长时间 = how long (in time). Chinese ask 多大 rather than 多小. For height of people and things use 米 (这棵树十米); distances in 公里 (= 一千米); weight in 公斤, 斤 (500 g) or 克.
see: 练习 · Practice (多高 / 多大 / 多长 / 多重 / 多远)
语法 · Grammar (疑问代词“多” + Adj)

items.py: Zhè kē shù duō gāo? — Shí mǐ.
items.en: How tall is this tree? — Ten metres.

items.zh: 你每天工作多长时间？——八个小时。
items.py: Nǐ měi tiān gōngzuò duō cháng shíjiān? — Bā ge xiǎoshí.
items.en: How long do you work each day? — Eight hours.

每天 every day, 每个星期 every week, 每个月 every month, 每年 every year, 每个小时 every hour, 每分钟 every minute, 每秒 every second (每分每秒 = every single moment). Ask how often with 几次: 你每个星期去几次健身房？ and how long with 多长时间. 多久……一次？ = how often. For '24/7' Chinese say 全年无休: 全年 the whole year, 无 = 没有, 休 = rest.
see: 练习 · Practice (每 + 几次 / 多长时间 How often, how long)

items.zh: 8 · 几乎 / 差不多 · 很少 vs 常常
items.en: 几乎每天 / 差不多每天 = almost every day. 很少 = rarely; its opposite is 常常 (often).

items.zh: 9 · Approximate numbers: 多 and 几
items.en: 二十多岁 = in your twenties (more than 20, less than 30). 五十多公斤 = 50-something kilos. 一米八几 = 1.8-something metres. 十几分钟 = ten-something minutes (11–19). 几十块 = some tens of yuan; 几百块 = a few hundred. Watch the order with money: 二十多块 = 20-something yuan (21, 25…), but 二十块多 = just over 20 yuan (20.3, 20.5).
see: 练习 · Practice (二十多 / 一米八几 / 十几 Approximate numbers)
